_comment: Station ID's cities (build plan G3): well-known Lower 48 cities whose airport has an NWS daily climate report (CLI), one station per city. 'station' is the report's name as the NWS writes it (underscores, '(ASOS)' and '(WAS ...)' taken out); 'state' is the city's, which can differ from the station's (Cincinnati's airport is in Kentucky); elev is metres and tz the IANA time zone, both from IEM's station list (tz added 2026-10-24 for Beat the Models' climate day). Made 2026-10-23 from the reports for Oct 1-22.
